sources.entry: Technical Interview Megarepo: study materials for SE/CS technical interviews

summary.one_liner: A curated README of links and resource pointers for preparing for software and computer science technical interviews, covering study topics, practice sites, videos, articles, and books.
summary.what_it_does: The README is a categorized list of interview-prep resources rather than a tool or codebase. It names study areas (algorithms, data structures, mathematics, operating systems, system design, interview tips) without linking content under them in the text provided. It lists practice-question sites such as Pramp, HackerRank, CodeWars, LeetCode, TopCoder, Project Euler, InterviewBit, InterviewCake, CodingBat, CodeRust, Codility, and an "Awesome Interview Questions" entry. It also collects a few videos, a set of articles on interviewing and job hunting, one book (Cracking the Coding Interview), and two Reddit communities for help. The README itself has no install steps or code.
use_cases: study algorithms and data structures for interviews
read advice on job interviews at tech companies
notable: Groups practice sites, videos, articles, and books for interview prep in one place
Lists Pramp for simulated live coding interviews
Includes an InterviewCake entry for past Google interview questions
Points to Reddit CS and CS career communities for help
caveats: The README is a link list with no described content, so study materials are not detailed or verified here
No install or code; it is a reference, not a runnable project
License not stated in the README
